orientation_comment: Camera has an 8 degree tilt about camera/world +X from the axis-aligned setup: camera +Z/forward is tilted from world -Z toward camera -Y/world +Y, and camera -Y/up is lifted from world +Y toward world +Z.
axis_mapping_comment: Camera +X/right -> world +X; camera +Y/down -> mostly world -Y with -Z component; camera +Z/forward -> mostly world -Z with +Y component.

camera_frame_z_flip_180.description: Optional transform for a 180 degree top-image rotation about the camera optical Z axis. Enable only when top-camera images are flipped by 180 degrees and state/action poses are expressed in this camera CV frame.
camera_frame_z_flip_180.position_rule: pos_flipped = R_flip @ pos; equivalent to [x, y, z] -> [-x, -y, z]
camera_frame_z_flip_180.orientation_rule: For wxyz quaternions, left-multiply by q_flip_wxyz: q_flipped = q_flip_wxyz ⊗ q. Do not right-multiply.
camera_frame_z_flip_180.pipeline_note: If source data is raw 12D joint angles, first run FK into camera-frame 16D pose, then apply this flip transform.
